zh.title: 工作过程自动收起，桌面交互更稳定（3.32.0 重发）
highlights: 会话工作过程按区间自动收起，交付正文、环境验证续轮和追加交付分别保留；阅读、选择文本及手动展开时延迟自动调整。
修复输入框横向滚动条、右栏文件树叠层及第 4 张图片无法加入；改进消息操作提示、会话总览已读状态、更新路由和账户设备额度。
修复 worker 恢复及重试缓存前缀，增加精确小时用量同步，并加固受保护路径、VS Code 运行时发现与 Linux 容器构建。
zh.notice: 与 v3.32.0 内容一致；v3.32.0 因灰度平台范围配置错误已在控制面撤销，未进入稳定通道。沿用现有会话、主题及折叠设置，无需迁移。已装 3.32.0 的用户直接更新即可。

en.title: Collapsible work intervals and a steadier desktop (3.32.0 reissue)
highlights: Conversation work collapses by interval while original deliveries, runtime verification and additional deliveries stay separate. Automatic changes wait while you read, select text or keep work expanded.
Fixes composer scrollbars, overlapping right-panel file trees and missing fourth-image slots. Improves message hints, overview read state, update routing and account/device quotas.
Fixes worker resume and retry cache prefixes, adds precise hourly usage sync, and hardens protected paths, VS Code runtime discovery and Linux container builds.
en.notice: Identical in content to v3.32.0, which was revoked in update control over a rollout platform-scope misconfiguration and never reached the stable channel. Existing sessions, themes and collapse settings require no migration; if you installed 3.32.0, simply take this update.
